summary: Sysco Corp and numerous subsidiary co-registrants filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-18 under an existing shelf registration (File 333-298926), covering the issuance of debt securities by the parent and guarantor subsidiaries. The excerpt contains only filer identification data, with no pricing, coupon, maturity, use-of-proceeds, or underwriting terms stated. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; no stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appears. Traders should await the accompanying term sheet or pricing press release for coupon, size, tenor, and any capital-structure implications.
